body:
Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles) by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affected PR #1025, exact merge `7646e0962afab6cc4f566439bb2f96890ae4b91e`, reviewed head `48e5bf1d506b2def1dab04f4e6e8e2a68f2d2195`; producing historical-name issue #1016 is closed.

`data/regional-review/followup-yugoslavia-423-slovenia-names-20261005/reproduction/reproduce-sistat-2017-roster.py` resolves Atlas part-22 from immutable commit `3042d1278e87dae00c26924c339e940c9fba240e`, but reads the current candidate roster, current GURS file, SURS response and historical GURS response from mutable filesystem paths without enforcing their recorded immutable hashes. It unconditionally opens the retained `2017-name-assessment.csv` and `reproduction-summary.json` for replacement. The external modern manifest gate checks their bytes; it does not execute the runner or add standalone input/output guards.

Actual original verification in a managed sparse detached slot, Python 3.12.14: two original executions with only the two exact output destinations redirected into fresh exclusive private files. Both reproduce the 28,686-byte CSV SHA256 `46ebdac5372a45cfc7e45d463be4a59e13364ae048f25551348a5c86a3bd056b` and 3,807-byte summary SHA256 `9c4008d680aecbf0415aec88703b90a791a6f9eda6033b4e659816879e2de407`. All 19 whole input/output contexts remain byte-identical. Independent parsed-UTC half-open interval joins confirm every one of the historical 53 native subjects, 899 historical records, 212 current municipality records, exact feature IDs/names at both 2017 dates, and SURS area pairs against retained originals. The historical result passes those correspondence checks.

Executed failing trigger: supply one complete `source/gurs-obcine-h-53-codes-2017.json` read-boundary fixture replacing only the effective name for municipality code 121 (Škocjan) with `Auditor synthetic historical name`, preserving code, feature ID, validity intervals and every other record. Text/raw reads receive the same whole fixture: 311,743 bytes, SHA256 `7976888767c7d3d972ca44bc672937c7ed414c0260b596ceecb474c22a0d2dfd`. Original runner succeeds, writes that name into its dated official-name columns, and generates a 28,737-byte CSV SHA256 `f7189695282107c8f4aa7a395dfe66a7a08bb30a57a14a21cb7a9612e1a39af1` and 3,807-byte summary SHA256 `b7bf380d7fe61f24b6c09ea78a1a7e5d7f0b5db46d268e7a60b681895cf277d4`. It reports changed current/historical correspondence in the output, but does not reject a changed historical source against the recorded immutable expected SHA. This is a missing standalone input guard, not proof the historical retained name result is wrong. External validation of an unchanged original manifest would reject these altered bytes.

Executed preservation trigger: pre-create two owned scratch output files with a sentinel and redirect only the original output destinations there, preserving the runner's actual write mode. Both are silently replaced with the original reports. No retained originals were edited. Conversely, a separate complete history fixture adding a second effective record for code 121 is genuinely rejected by the existing uniqueness assertion before any output. Preserve that useful validity safeguard.

Expected: an additive runner resolves/checks all consumed whole input/code/scope/request hashes and exact subject/code/feature correspondence before emission, preserves the original reports, and writes only fresh exclusive versioned outputs. It rejects the demonstrated source change and existing destinations before writing. Names/validity are retained-source findings, not authenticated merely because a JSON field says verified.

Bounded additive source-only geography erratum, at most two PRs, owned exclusively `data/regional-review/slovenia-history-reproduction-1016-erratum/`:

- Exactly the 53 #1016 native subjects below; original #423 parents/source catalog are read-only contexts. Resolve the 19 complete retained contexts at their true immutable commits, including source responses, requests, candidate/current crosswalk and code. Preserve every original script/source/roster/CSV/summary/manifest. No shared runtime, name/hierarchy/geometry edit.
- Bind and enforce immutable consumed inputs, code, scope, request and the actual baseline vintage before generation. Preserve explicit current/historical date distinctions and name/locale/source-lineage limits. Verify code/ID/source-feature uniqueness and exact issue roster, meaningful dated interval semantics and retained source correspondence independently.
- Execute twice to fresh exclusive outputs. Retain meaningful negatives for the demonstrated historical-name drift, changed other inputs/code/roster/requests, missing/duplicate/outside subjects, ambiguous validity intervals and existing outputs; prove rejection before emission and byte-identical originals. Retain actual input/output/method/metric bindings and substantive independent exact-head source/implementation review.

Success: the complete historical-name fixture is rejected against immutable pins before emission; pre-existing outputs are rejected; two fresh deterministic reports preserve original byte comparisons; exact 53 identities and dated joins remain verified; all originals stay unchanged. Do not use current-name agreement as historical evidence, adjudicate source authority/licensing, decide product locale, edit core names/geometry/hierarchy, approve geography, import, merge or deploy.

Readiness: #1016 is closed with its canonical author reservation released. Complete open/closed issue and open-PR pagination found only the closed original historical-name task for this packet and no open owner of the new prefix. The demonstrated standalone safeguards use available, whole, bounded inputs; no unavailable official primary-source body is needed to reject immutable-byte drift. No implementation reservation is taken. #1156 owns the earlier #992 original scope/provenance/restoration gap and #1180 the later #1020 anomaly writer, not this different #1025 reproducer; preserve their scopes. The new task does not own primary-source restoration or geographic/name implementation.

Limits: retained 899-record GURS history and current/SURS files have been checked mechanically and against their committed hashes, not independently authenticated from upstream during this audit. Rights/access-law/history-service/aggregate source pages are restoration-only here. Source spelling mechanism, product locale policy, geometry, parent suitability, neighboring granularity and regional approval remain outside this task. Original #1025 audit stays Incomplete for unverified source claims; corrective PRs require their own audits.

Admission: 19 whole contexts total 19,238,471 ordinary bytes plus eight MiB whole-fixture/output reserve = 27,627,079 bytes per genuinely complete original/probe phase. All ordinary/decoded objects ≤32 MiB, each phase ≤256 MiB, descriptors ≤512. Recalculate before new execution; no stream/extract cap bypass.
